fixturePreparation.text: The fresh Business User completed Portal onboarding once (Step 1 of 5, Step 2 of 5, Step 2 of 5, Step 3 of 5, Step 4 of 5, Step 5 of 5) with the first Department, the name DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations Business 765363, and the default theme and notification choices.

Daniel Okafor invited four fresh fictional staff accounts through the invites API (DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations Legal Own List, Legal Los Angeles, Legal No Date Bell, and Admin, stamp 765363); each set a derived in-memory password from its activation mail. A fresh Business User (doc032-compata-conv-765363-b1@helix.example) was created by its first Portal magic-link sign-in. Every fresh account had its timezone set to America/Los_Angeles through the preferences API so no morning round could serve it before its fixtures were ready.

The fresh Business User submitted R-16 and R-17 through the Requests API. Daniel Okafor converted R-16 to Sales Contract C-69, added the four fresh staff accounts to its team, made the fresh Administrator its Legal Owner (HTTP 200), created Tasks due 2026-09-28 for the fresh Administrator and Legal No Date Bell, and added the Key dates "765363 three-day check" on 2026-10-01 and "765363 seven-day check" on 2026-10-05 through the API. R-17 stays unconverted.

At 2026-09-28T07:16:57.488Z the fresh Legal Own List, Legal No Date Bell, Admin and Business accounts had their saved timezone cleared (so the morning process uses UTC) through the preferences API; Legal Los Angeles kept America/Los_Angeles. The next hourly morning round runs at the top of the hour UTC.

The fresh Business User (DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations Business 765363) submitted four Legal question Requests through the Portal API (R-30, R-31, R-32, R-33). Daniel Okafor converted R-30 to Sales Contract C-92, R-31 to Litigation Matter M-29, and R-33 to Sales Contract C-93 through the convert API; R-32 stays unconverted. Daniel added Nadia Haddad to the C-92 and M-29 teams through the team API.
Daniel Okafor posted 55 Matter Team comments and one Legal Only comment on M-29 through the comments API, to give the Matter more than one page of comments.
Nadia Haddad posted one working_team comment on C-92 and one on R-32 through the comments API to stand in for older Working Team comments; the composer does not offer that tier.
Nadia Haddad added the Task "DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations 765363 prepare the signing pack" due 2026-10-08 on C-92 through the tasks API.

Nadia Haddad made record progress through the API as fixtures for Portal History: C-92 Draft to Internal review (a Stage move), Internal review to With counterparty (same Stage), a title change, deal_desk_reference (Visible on Portal) and governing_law (not on the Portal) edits, two Tasks added (one due 2026-10-12), one edited, one completed, a reorder, one removed; M-29 (closed with a note in the first run) moved to In progress, then budget_approved (Visible on Portal) and external_counsel (not on the Portal) edits. Results: contract to Internal review 200, contract to With counterparty 200, contract title 200, portal-visible field 200, hidden field 200, task added 201, task added 2 201, task edited 200, task completed 200, task reordered 404, task removed 200, matter to In progress 200, matter portal-visible field 200, matter hidden field 200.
Nadia Haddad closed M-29 with a closing note through the API after the Matter conversation checks.

Daniel Okafor created C-113 "DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations 765363 confidential side letter", marked it Confidential (Nadia Haddad is not on its team), and linked C-92 to it as related, through the API.
Daniel Okafor archived C-93 through the archive API after posting a Contract Team comment with paper in the browser.

Daniel Okafor added Amara Nwosu (Business User) to the C-92 team through the team API, then removed her again. He then cleared the Business Owner (HTTP 200; the API refuses to take the Business Owner off the team), removed the requester from the team (HTTP 200), and afterwards restored both.
Nadia Haddad posted eleven Contract Team comments mentioning Legal Own List on C-69 through the comments API to give that account more than nine unread bell items.
Nadia Haddad requested approval of C-69 from Legal Own List through the approvals API (approval 01a0e707-d8d5-75b3-996b-4515e87853e9).
Legal Own List answered approval 01a0e707-d8d5-75b3-996b-4515e87853e9 through the decision API (HTTP 200); the approval procedure itself belongs to the contract-approvals guide.
Nadia Haddad posted sixteen more mentions of Legal Own List on C-69 through the comments API so the bell has more than one page.
The fresh Business User submitted R-70 through the Requests API for the New requests and Request receipt checks.

Organization MCP settings before the API key checks: {"enabled":false,"legalApiKeysEnabled":false,"businessApiKeysEnabled":false}. Daniel Okafor set {"enabled":true,"legalApiKeysEnabled":true,"businessApiKeysEnabled":true} through the MCP settings API (HTTP 200) for the API key and MCP attribution checks.

Legal Own List requested an API key for the Client "Claude" (comments Toolset, write) through the API key request API (request 01a0e709-2efe-7a56-9ed1-b7b8ac88d648); the request procedure belongs to the Configure MCP guide.
Legal Own List read the one-time key in memory and posted one Contract Team comment on C-69 through the MCP endpoint's openlaw_comment_post tool (HTTP 200); the key was never written down.
Legal Own List revoked the API key after the check (HTTP 200).
The fresh Business User requested an API key for "Claude" (comments, read) through the API key request API (request 01a0e709-6fea-72cc-9bfa-9a91c524dceb).
Daniel Okafor restored the organization MCP settings to {"enabled":false,"legalApiKeysEnabled":false,"businessApiKeysEnabled":false} (HTTP 200).
Daniel Okafor added Amara Nwosu to the C-69 team for the comparison and removed her afterwards (HTTP 200).
Nadia Haddad requested approval of C-69 from the fresh Business User through the approvals API (approval 01a0e70a-42d2-7850-a7d9-e2a4d75f4748).
Nadia Haddad cancelled that approval request through the approvals API (HTTP 200).
Daniel Okafor cleared the Business Owner (HTTP 200), removed the fresh Business User from the C-69 team (HTTP 200), and restored both afterwards, through the API, for the Portal bell access check.
Nadia Haddad added the Task "DOC-032 compat compat-a conversations 765363 email task" assigned to Legal Own List on C-69 through the tasks API.
The fresh Administrator turned "Include comment words in email" off in Settings, Organization, Notifications for one mention email, then turned it back on.
